what_this_is: Every quantitative claim in the companion note, recomputed here from the pinned per-item evaluator outputs using the evaluator's own scoring functions (scripts/musique_decompositions_evaluator.py). Item ids and numbers only; no dataset step text.

provenance.eval_set: MuSiQue ADR 0007 pinned 600 (200 per gold hop depth), seed 42
provenance.diagnostic_authority: docs/METRICS.md 4.1 (named house diagnostic, not a house metric)

finding_2b_placeholder_syntax_census.why: the evaluator's reference-validity term only matches bracketed [#k]; the gold decompositions of this eval set use bare #k exclusively

finding_3_composite_exchange_rates.source_for_that_figure: docs/analysis/composite-score-literature-check.md 4.2, reproduced here structurally: the single item owns the whole micro denominator, so the 0.2-weighted term goes 1.0 -> 0.0

step_count_term_is_clamped_not_unbounded.per_item_composite_reason: the reference term is a micro rate and the step-count term a MAE, so the composite is an aggregate of aggregates; T_TEST_STATISTICS excludes it

finding_4_bootstrap_ci_asymmetry.reproduction_is_bit_identical: reproduced with the evaluator's own _statistic_arrays/_statistics_for, seed 42, 10000 iterations, chunk 1000, items aligned by sorted item_id. The house-composite rows below match experiments/exp-008/metrics.json arm_comparison_details bit for bit: full_train_vs_unguided difference 0.313721990971991, ci_low 0.10547500797813295, ci_high 0.33070602055352055; oracle_guided_vs_unguided difference 0.2098428964553965, ci_low 0.005844228977041489, ci_high 0.21888995490620491. The mode decomposition is therefore a decomposition of the committed intervals themselves, not of a re-run.

finding_6_null_systems_on_this_eval_set.why: PR #38 measured null-system floors on v1 artifacts; these are recomputed on the ADR 0007 pinned 600 so the comparison to exp-004/005/008 is same-eval-set

finding_7_per_hop_and_cap_simulation.cap_simulation_is_a_simulation: predicted step lists truncated to the first N and rescored with the evaluator's own _step_prf / _ordered_step_accuracy / _exact_decomposition_match. No model was run. It approximates a post-hoc truncation, NOT a generation-time cap, which would also change the decoded text.

finding_8_four_hop_conditioned_on_predic.confound: conditioning on the model's own predicted step count is not a randomised comparison -- items it counts correctly may be the easier items. Suggestive, not causal.

finding_9_bare_hash_chain_validity.definition: a bare #k reference is valid when 1 <= k < its own 1-based step index; forward/self means k >= own index, i.e. unresolvable at that step
finding_9_bare_hash_chain_validity.not_a_house_metric: the evaluator does not compute this -- its reference-validity term matches bracketed [#k] only. Measured in this note.

finding_10_surface_form_and_em.step_f1_is_exact_set_match: _step_prf builds a SET of normalized step strings and intersects; ordered_step_accuracy compares position by position; both are string-exact after normalization
finding_10_surface_form_and_em.fuzzy_em_caveat: the fuzzy-EM figure is a SIMULATION using difflib character ratio at 0.9 on normalized steps. It is an illustration of how much of EM's zero is surface form, not a proposed metric.

finding_11_representative_item_ids.why: ids only, so a reader can pull the rows from the per-item files on the box
